description: Prepares a plan payment in USDC. Send method (get_subscription lists the methods open to your account and the recommended one); without it, the server picks: enough free USDC on Hyperliquid gives hyperliquid, otherwise ethereum, and the answer carries method. method ethereum: returns tx { to, data, value }, a USDC transfer on Ethereum (chainId 1) to send from your wallet `from`, with chainId, token, receiver and amountUnits to check first (USDC contract 0xa0b86991c6218b36c1d19d4a2e9eb0ce3606eb48, receiver of get_subscription, price × 1,000,000, value 0x0, tx.data = transfer(receiver, amountUnits)); Paying on Ethereum needs your own wallet and an Ethereum connection to send the transaction (WakeTrades does not send it); method hyperliquid works through this MCP server alone. nothing to submit, the plan is applied about a minute after the block (get_payment_status with tx = the transaction hash). method hyperliquid: returns the payment action and the EIP-712 typedData to sign for a plan (exact price, WakeTrades receiver): usdSend from your free perps USDC, or sendAsset from your spot USDC when the perps balance is short (unified account). The free trial must have started. Before signing, check typedData (not only action): primaryType HyperliquidTransaction:UsdSend or HyperliquidTransaction:SendAsset (SendAsset: message.token is USDC), message.destination = receiver and message.amount = your plan's price, both from get_subscription; never sign a Withdraw.
name: prepare_payment
title: Prepare a plan payment
